dedupe_keys.name: madrid general urban plan 1997 pgoum 97 building conditions map service

description: Dirección General de Planificación Estratégica, Madrid City Council publishes a map service of the building conditions plan of the 1997 General Urban Plan of Madrid as published after final approval on 19 April 1997, showing the depths and weighted buildability coefficient for new buildings or general restructuring on plots under Zoning Norm 1 and the plots whose special conditions are set in a detailed sheet. Coverage: the city of Madrid; the plan is as approved in 1997 and the portal record was last modified on 2026-07-29. Format and access: WMS, ZIP, downloadable without registration from the Madrid City Council open data portal (datos.madrid.es). Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 (CC BY 4.0, legal code in Spanish on the portal); cost: free. Caveats: the layer reflects the 1997 plan as approved and not later modifications, the catalogue lists a zip download (the page describes a map service) and update frequency as undefined, and the layer was not opened. Simulation uses: building-envelope and buildability constraints for urban growth, densification and exposure scenarios in the city. Related catalogue records: Arbolado en parques y zonas verdes de Madrid (municipal tree inventory, yearly files) (data-madrid-arbolado-parques-zonas-verdes); OpenStreetMap (data-openstreetmap).
